features.name: Minimal adjudicate request payload
features.description: Keep messages as the adjudication evidence while removing unrelated passthrough fields and full annotation payloads from model requests.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: Inspection confirmed adjudicate was not sending whole rows but was sending full `annotation`. RED `go test ./internal/service -run '^TestAdjudicateSendsMinimalJudgmentPrompt$' -count=1 -v` failed because `model_judgment` included `method`, `extended_info`, `is_attack`, and `case_type`. GREEN keeps `messages`, `original_label`, `model_label`, and reason fields while sending only `annotation.explanation` as the model judgment. `go test . -run '^TestRunAdjudicateOutputsMASBFormat$' -count=1 -v`, `go test ./... -count=1`, `go test -race . ./internal/service ./internal/lib/configs -count=1`, `git diff --check`, `go build -trimpath -o ./sendllm .`, and `./init.sh` all exited 0.

features.name: SQLite-backed concurrent adjudicate mode
features.description: Make adjudicate mode use SQLite as its durable progress source, support interruption/resume, reset failed rows on restart, and run model calls with real bounded concurrency.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: adjudicate mode now opens `task.state`, imports differences into SQLite, resets failed rows to pending on startup, runs through the shared Runner with configured limiter concurrency, and atomically exports success/failed JSONL from SQLite terminal state. It sends only required adjudication evidence: `messages`, normalized original/model labels, original reason from `meta.source_fields.reason`, and model reason from `annotation.explanation`. Follow-up on 2026-08-13: Ctrl+C now exports current succeeded adjudicate rows using a bounded terminal export context before returning interrupted.
